summary: Welded rolled-steel hull and turret, ~15 mm all round (turret front, sides, roof and hull per FAS / GlobalSecurity / Wikipedia). Proof against 7.62 mm ball and most 152/155 mm splinters beyond ~20-30 m; 12.7/14.5 mm AP, 30 mm, any RPG/ATGM, FPV-drone shaped charges and top-attack submunitions defeat it. The sloped glacis and turret cheeks give ~20-30 mm line of sight. Projectiles and especially propellant charges fill the turret rear and the hull centre: a penetration of the turret bustle or fighting compartment usually ends in a cook-off.

notes: koi.legion.wplus.net lists 50-80 mm hull/turret armour; this contradicts FAS/GlobalSecurity/Wikipedia (15 mm) and the vehicle mass budget, so the 15 mm figure is used.
Line-of-sight values: glacis 15 mm at ~60 deg -> 30; lower front plate ~55 deg -> 25; turret cheeks ~40 deg -> 20.
